# IRunner.BoostMeter property

What its boost meter holds, from 0 to [`MaxBoostMeter`](./MaxBoostMeter.md).

```csharp
public float BoostMeter { get; }
```

## Remarks

Each game counts the meters of the other games' runners on its own, so the meter of a runner this game does not play is an estimate.
